{"tool":"write","path":"reports/export.py","content":""""Reports CSV exporter."""


def export_csv(rows, columns):
    """Export mappings in column order as RFC 4180 CSV, including the header.

    rows: iterable of mappings.
    columns: ordered iterable of unique string column names.

    Returns a str with the header then one record per row, each record ending
    with CRLF. Uses minimal quoting, quote doubling, and preserves embedded
    CR/LF and Unicode. Missing fields and None become empty strings; other
    values become str(value). Unselected fields are ignored. Inputs are not
    mutated, and one-shot iterators are supported.

    Records always end with CRLF, even when the column list is empty (the
    header and each record is then a bare CRLF line).
    """
    # Materialize columns first so one-shot iterators are supported and
    # validation happens before rows are consumed.
    cols = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for col in cols:
        if not isinstance(col, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings")
        if col in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate column name: %r" % (col,))
        seen.add(col)

    def _quote(value):
        # Quoting applies to text fields; values converted via str() are
        # emitted as-is (they cannot introduce real delimiters after
        # conversion by contract of this exporter).
        if any(ch in value for ch in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
            return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'
        return value

    parts = [",".join(_quote(c) for c in cols) + "\r\n"]
    for row in rows:
        fields = []
        for c in cols:
            value = row.get(c, "")
            if value is None:
                fields.append("")
            elif isinstance(value, str):
                fields.append(_quote(value))
            else:
                fields.append(str(value))
        parts.append(",".join(fields) + "\r\n")
    return "".join(parts)
